reports.text: Water entered ground floor of 8 houses near the sangam. Families on rooftops. Need tarps and dry food.
Colony road washed. Two injured. PHC asking for tetanus and ORS.
Loud slide heard towards Maneri. Highway closed. Buses stuck this side. No trucks from HQ since morning.
Temple committee: 40 winter staff plus 12 pilgrims. LPG and rice for two days only.
Jhala track open on foot only. Highway towards Sukki buried. Army camp can receive airdrop.
Elderly ward cannot walk the bypass. Request mule or light vehicle if jeep track holds.
